The change brings ‌Apple Music‌ Classical in line with ‌Apple Music‌'s new visual identity, which Apple introduced last month, replacing its familiar red branding with a monochrome appearance.

‌Apple Music‌ Classical is included with ‌Apple Music‌ subscriptions at no additional cost. The app offers search tailored to classical recordings, composer biographies, album booklets, time-synced listening guides, and curated stations.

evidence.title: New Apple Music Classical update matches wider Music rebrand

units.text: Apple has continued its Apple Music rebrand, bringing a new black-and-white icon and revamped user interface to its Apple Music Classical app for iPhone and iPad.

The new update follows a larger rebrand that has removed the familiar red coloring from Apple Music's icon and marketing materials. It also used the new design identity when unveiling Apple Music Hall in Battersea, London.

Alongside the removal of red as a base color, the new look includes blue accents throughout. This even extends to the use of blue links rather than the traditional red ones that users are more accustomed to.
Notably, Apple's release notes do not mention the new look. Instead, they simply point to improvements to the app's stability and performance.
Apple Music Classical looks great on iPhone Duo

Apple Music Classical streams music in much the same way as the standard Music app, but with adjustments made to better accommodate classical works. Classical music doesn't always fit into the traditional album-based framework of most music apps, something the Apple Music Classical app counters with a bespoke design.
Apple Music Classical plays host to a wide array of music
The newly updated app builds on the previous Liquid Glass update that arrived alongside iOS 26 in 2025. It now more closely matches the rest of Apple's first-party offerings, especially Apple Music.

The newly updated app is available for download from the App Store now. Apple Music Classical is included as part of the Apple Music subscription at no extra cost, and has its own apps across Apple's platforms.

新一代理想 MEGA Home、全新理想 i9 Home

VLA 驾驶 / 全场景导航辅助驾驶（NOA）
新增校车、水泥搅拌车、市政清洁车的感知与渲染

新增队长广播：创建小队的用户可发起 30s 广播

新增状态栏手车互联管理、语音控制、方向盘按键控制，支持长按语音按键唤醒 Siri

units.text: As it always does, in the run up to the holidays Apple has extended its return window. With some exceptions, buyers now have until early January 2027 to change their minds.
Apple does this every year, and each time the broad strokes are the same. From now until Christmas Day, most items can be returned until a date in early January.
For this year, Apple has announced that the return date is January 8, 2027. It has also, though, detailed what is excluded from that:
Apple Gift Cards
Apple developer membership and other products
Installed software or upgrades from the App Store
Most importantly, though, is what happens with the return of an iPhone or a cellular iPad, if it were bought locked to a particular carrier.
"Wireless carriers have different service-cancellation policies," notes Apple. "Returning your iPhone or iPad may not automatically cancel or reset your wireless account."
Consequently Apple says that you "are responsible for your wireless service agreement."

Note, too, that Apple's returns policy only applies to items bought from either a retail Apple Store or its online one. In the case of an online order, the date the product is received is used to determine eligibility, not the order day.

All of this is the same as before, except that Apple has added back in its rejection of gift cards which it omitted in 2025. For completeness, the terms and conditions still include references to opened software, decades since Apple sold any apps in boxes.

These are the terms as apply to US customers, although there are very similar ones for international buyers. There is also a series of additional returns steps for customers in Puerto Rico, which Apple details on its returns page.

units.text: Apple's Extended Return Policy Now in Effect for 2026 Holiday Season

Apple's extended return policy went into effect today for the 2026 holiday shopping season. The policy applies to most products sold by Apple online and in its stores, with a few exceptions, including some carrier-financed iPhones and iPads.

In the U.S., Canada, the U.K., Ireland, Germany, the Netherlands, Australia, New Zealand, Singapore, and many other countries, most products purchased between November 6 and December 25 of this year may be returned through January 8, 2027, according to Apple's website. All purchases made after December 25 in those countries are subject to Apple's standard 14-day return policy (15 days in Canada).
For online orders, Apple says products "received" on November 6 through December 25 are eligible for return through January 8.

In some countries, such as Mexico, Italy, Spain, and Japan, the return window is slightly longer. Apple says eligible products purchased in those countries between November 6 and January 6, 2027 may be returned through January 20, 2027.
This policy applies to purchases at Apple Stores, on Apple.com, and in the Apple Store app.
Apple has also updated its online store with holiday theming and gift recommendations.

units.text: Apple has rolled out its holiday theming at the online Apple Store, and with it a new, extended return policy has just been put into place. Here are the details.
Apple Store orders received starting today are eligible for return through January 8
Every year for the holiday season, like many other retailers, Apple institutes an extended return period for eligible purchases.
Today that extended return window has officially kicked off. Per Apple’s website:
Holiday Return Policy

Eligible products at the Apple Store Online that are received between November 6, 2026 and December 25, 2026, may be returned through January 8, 2027. Please note that all other terms and conditions provided in the Apple Store Online Sales and Refunds Policy are still applicable with respect to such products purchased. iPhone purchases that are carrier-financed with T-Mobile or Verizon are not eligible and are subject to standard return policy. iPad purchases that are carrier-financed with Verizon are not eligible and are subject to standard return policy. All purchases made after December 25, 2026 are subject to the Standard Return Policy.
The extended return window applies to all products. However, Apple does state that as always, certain types of products are ineligible for return altogether. They include:
Opened software
Electronic Software Downloads
Software Up-to-Date Program Products (software upgrades)
Apple Gift Cards (includes previous generation Apple Store Gift Cards and App Store & iTunes Gift Cards)
Apple Developer products (membership, technical support incidents, WWDC tickets)
Most of the year, the Apple Store has a 14-day return policy. But unless you’re a last-minute shopper, that wouldn’t work very well for any product you intend to gift.
Thus, Apple’s extended return window means any purchase you make as a holiday gift won’t have its return period end before the holidays even arrive.

evidence.title: Apple’s DOJ antitrust battle sparks disputes with Epic, Samsung, Oura, Roblox, more

units.text: Several tech companies are pushing back against subpoenas issued by Apple and the DOJ in their ongoing antitrust battle. Here are the details.
A bit of background

In March 2024, the Department of Justice and 15 states, plus the District of Columbia, filed a lawsuit accusing Apple of restricting competition, limiting interoperability with rival products, and making it harder for consumers to switch to competing devices. Apple denies these allegations.

Since then, despite recent reports of settlement talks happening behind the scenes, the two sides have clashed repeatedly over discovery, which is the pretrial process through which both sides exchange evidence relevant to the case.

As part of its effort to refute the DOJ’s arguments, Apple has subpoenaed several third-party companies and organizations, seeking documents and information relevant to its defense. That includes Epic Games, Samsung Electronics America, Meta, Oura, Garmin, Playco, Ultrahuman, PayPal, Match Group, and the Connectivity Standards Alliance, among others.

The DOJ and plaintiff states, in turn, have issued their own subpoenas, including to Roblox, Epic Games, Snap, and the Connectivity Standards Alliance, seeking evidence to support their allegations against Apple.
Google, Microsoft, JPMorgan Chase, and Capital One are also named in legal documents.

In essence, both sides are trying to use data from Apple’s competitors and companies with which it has commercial relationships to establish how its policies affect competition, and whether those policies are justified or constitute anticompetitive behavior.
Short subheading

Over the past couple of days, multiple letters submitted to the court reveal disagreements over the scope of the subpoenas, the information being requested, and whether the companies should be required to produce certain documents.

Epic Games, for instance, argues that Apple’s requests for documents from three previous lawsuits (Epic v. Apple in the US, Epic v. Apple in Australia, and Epic v. Google in the US), along with extensive searches of internal files belonging to three senior executives, including its CEO, would be disproportionately burdensome.

Still, the company has offered to produce several categories of information, including Fortnite user and revenue data, contracts with Google and Samsung, and records relating to Apple’s Core Technology Fee.
Samsung, in turn, has agreed to search documents belonging to two executives, which the company says have yielded nearly 900,000 documents matching the agreed-upon search terms.

However, Apple wants to expand the searches to six additional executives, including Samsung Electronics America’s current and former CEOs, and obtain deposition transcripts from Samsung executives who testified in the DOJ’s antitrust lawsuit against Google.
The companies also disagree over whether Samsung Electronics America should be required to produce documents held by its South Korean parent company, which is a dispute we covered here before.

As for Oura, the company is pushing back on several fronts, including whether Apple should reimburse it for reviewing more than 32,000 additional documents, and whether it may withhold or redact certain information it considers trade secrets.
Garmin has raised similar objections to Apple’s requests for confidential financial and strategic information.

Roblox, which is the only company among these recent filings subpoenaed by the DOJ and plaintiff states rather than Apple or other plaintiffs, is disputing requests for information about its relationship with Apple and how Apple’s App Store policies are applied. The government, meanwhile, argues that the documents could help establish whether Apple consistently applies its App Store Guidelines to developers.

Another interesting dispute involves Japan-based instant gaming company Playco, which is resisting Apple’s requests for documents concerning its efforts to influence App Store policies, including lobbying activities.
Playco argues that producing these materials would violate its First Amendment rights, citing a 2021 court decision involving similar requests Apple made to Match Group.
Several of the companies have also requested until November 11 to continue negotiations before their disputes are formally declared at an impasse, potentially avoiding further court intervention.
All of this is happening against the backdrop of another dispute between Apple and the DOJ involving the company’s efforts to obtain documents from 14 federal agencies.
Although a special master has twice sided with Apple, the order remains on hold while the court considers the government’s appeal.

units.text: 美国苹果公司正面临来自国会民主党人的新一轮质询。原因是此前曝光的一份捐款名单显示，苹果曾承诺为美国总统唐纳德·特朗普推动建设的白宫宴会厅项目提供2500万美元资金支持，而这一消息随即引发有关企业政治捐款透明度和潜在利益冲突的讨论。
根据此前披露的内部募款记录，苹果与英伟达均承诺向白宫宴会厅建设项目捐赠2500万美元，是已知金额最高的捐助者之一。相关文件显示，该项目目前已获得超过3.3亿美元私人承诺资金，捐款者包括多家大型科技企业以及与联邦政府存在业务往来的公司。特朗普本人虽然曾表示将参与项目出资，但并未出现在公开流传的捐赠名单中。
针对这一情况，多名民主党议员要求苹果向投资者及公众披露更多信息，包括捐款的决策过程、董事会在其中发挥的作用、资金来源，以及公司是否评估过相关捐款可能带来的商业和声誉风险。
批评者认为，当大型科技企业向与总统直接相关的项目提供巨额资金时，公众有必要了解这些资金背后的决策依据，以及是否存在影响政府政策、公平竞争或监管决策的可能性。他们指出，苹果等企业在反垄断审查、贸易政策、政府采购以及其他联邦事务中均与美国政府存在重要利益关联，因此捐款行为应接受更高程度的透明度审查。
民主党方面还表示，上市公司向政治相关项目提供大额资金时，投资者理应了解资金用途及预期影响，以便评估相关决策是否符合股东利益。
目前，苹果尚未公开说明2500万美元捐款的具体背景。此前在相关捐款信息曝光后，苹果拒绝就此事发表评论。白宫则为相关募款活动辩护，称支持者来自众多美国企业和个人，并认为如果由纳税人承担全部建设费用，同样会引发批评。
与此同时，特朗普政府批评外界对项目的质疑属于政治炒作，并对捐款信息泄露事件表示不满。白宫发言人此前强调，相关项目主要依靠私人资金建设，而非联邦财政支出。
不过，随着捐款名单曝光以及多家大型科技企业被卷入讨论，围绕白宫宴会厅项目的争议仍在持续发酵。民主党议员希望通过信息披露要求进一步了解苹果参与该项目的全过程，而这一事件也再次引发美国政商关系、企业政治捐款透明度以及科技行业影响力等议题的广泛讨论。

units.text: 快科技11月7日消息，苹果宣布，上市仅两周的折叠屏iPhone Duo已经有超过10万款应用完成优化。
这些应用均基于iOS 27.1及以上版本SDK开发，可完整适配内外屏的全宽显示，并针对状态栏垂直控件布局完成调整，所有适配应用在App Store中带有专属“Made for iPhone Duo”标识，方便用户识别。
苹果全球开发者关系副总裁Susan Prescott表示，开发者对iPhone Duo的响应速度超出预期，目前每天仍有数千款优化后的应用上架App Store。
过去一个月，苹果已在全球19座城市举办超过50场线下开发者工坊，帮助开发者快速完成适配工作。
目前已完成适配的热门应用覆盖办公、影音、社交、工具等多个品类，包括微软Office全家桶、WhatsApp、YouTube、Netflix、Instagram、Zoom、亚马逊Prime Video等。
此外，iOS 27.2版本已为iPhone Duo新增Apple Pencil（USB-C）支持，可实现绘图、笔记、文档批注等拓展功能。
尽管整体适配进度较快，但在数百万款应用的总量基数下，仍有大量热门应用尚未完成适配。
未适配清单涵盖谷歌办公套件、微软Teams、星巴克、Steam、Uber Eats、YouTube Music、PayPal等多个领域的头部应用。
适配程度分成三档：用iOS 27.1 SDK构建的应用能铺满内外两块屏幕；用iOS 27 SDK构建的应用可以放大填满内屏大部分区域，但会避开右边缘的状态栏；用iOS 26或更早SDK构建的应用只能居中运行，左右两侧留下大片黑边。
苹果称适配本身并不复杂，使用标准SwiftUI和UIKit组件的应用会自动适配每块屏幕，控件自动移到状态栏，内屏支持多列布局，新API还能针对不同折叠姿态单独调整。

units.text: Apple says that developers have been rapidly adapting their apps for the iPhone Duo's twin screens, with thousands of new ones being added daily.

The lack of apps that hadn't been updated for the iPhone Duo was definitely the device's Achilles' heel. But as AppleInsider said, that problem was small, getting smaller, and by the time most buyers get their iPhone Duo, it will be gone.
Now in a statement to AppleInsider, Apple has boasted about the rate at which developers are updating to take advantage of the iPhone Duo.

"It's been wonderful to see how quickly developers have embraced iPhone Duo, and we're grateful for their creativity and innovation," Susan Prescott, Apple's vice president of Worldwide Developer Relations. "Today there are well over 100,000 apps built for iPhone Duo already live on the App Store, and thousands of optimized apps are being added to the store each day."
Prescott made similar remarks in late October 2026, but since then has added more detail about how Apple is working with developers.

"In the last month alone, thousands of developers have joined us for workshops in 19 cities around the world to experience iPhone Duo firsthand and bring updated apps to their users," she said. "The enthusiasm has been incredible, and we're excited to see the pace of updates continue to accelerate as more and more apps optimize for iPhone Duo."

Separately, a particularly notable update for the iPhone Duo has been from Google. Larger firms such as Google and Microsoft have often been very late to adopting new Apple requirements, but Google has rapidly updated its Maps app.
Why apps need updating

If developers have consistently followed Apple's recommendations, then their apps already make some use of the iPhone Duo's two screens. But to fully use the width of both the external and internal screens, developers need to do some work.
How the updated Google Maps uses the whole of the inner and outer displays on the iPhone Duo.
Apple says that this extra work is minor. But if developers have not been following those recommendations, then the effort needed is much more substantial.
It's also much more important, too. Such apps are shown in the center of the inner screen with large black bars to left and right.

Users can expand the app to more or less fill the screen, but it looks poor. Plus users can drag such an app to one side of the screen or the other, and then open a second app to fill up the rest of the screen.

But then beyond their appearance, apps that have been properly updated for the iPhone Duo make extra use of the device's form factor. Apps can tell how wide open the device is, for instance, and adjust their controls to best serve the user.

units.text: Apple Says More Than 100,000 Apps Optimized for iPhone Duo, Here's What's Still Missing

Apple today announced that more than 100,000 apps have been optimized for the iPhone Duo, released two weeks ago. We confirmed that this figure refers to apps built with the iOS 27.1 SDK or later, meaning these apps fill the full width of the iPhone Duo's inner and outer displays and have vertical controls in the status bar.
A statement from Susan Prescott, Apple's Vice President of Worldwide Developer Relations:

It's been wonderful to see how quickly developers have embraced iPhone Duo, and we're grateful for their creativity and innovation. Today there are well over 100,000 apps built for iPhone Duo already live on the App Store, and thousands of optimized apps are being added to the store each day. In the last month alone, thousands of developers have joined us for workshops in 19 cities around the world to experience iPhone Duo firsthand and bring updated apps to their users. The enthusiasm has been incredible, and we're excited to see the pace of updates continue to accelerate as more and more apps optimize for iPhone Duo.

Apple said thousands of apps optimized for the iPhone Duo are being added to the App Store each day, with recent examples including Microsoft's Excel, OneNote, PowerPoint, and Word apps, along with the Etsy, Goodnotes, Halide Mark III, NBA, NHL, and Zoom apps. Other apps optimized for the device include Amazon Prime Video, Fantastical, Flighty, Instagram, MLB, Netflix, SmartGym, WhatsApp, YouTube, and more. There are too many to list.
Apps optimized for the iPhone Duo have a "Made for iPhone Duo" badge in their App Store listings on the device, making them easy to identify.

iOS 27.2 added Apple Pencil (USB-C) support to the iPhone Duo, enabling users to draw in apps like Procreate Pocket, take notes in Apple Notes, Fineliner, and TypeDraw, and mark up documents in apps like Preview on the device.

On the other hand, with millions of apps available in the App Store, there are unsurprisingly many apps that are still not optimized for the iPhone Duo, with the following examples listed in alphabetical order: AMC Theaters, Amazon Fire TV, Apple Store, Best Buy, Bluesky, Delta, DoorDash, Duolingo, Fandango, FedEx, Goodreads, Google Docs, Google Home, Google Sheets, Google Slides, GrubHub, JetBlue, Libby, Microsoft Authenticator, Microsoft Teams, MTA, Nike, PayPal, PictureThis, Ring, Southwest, Spectrum TV, Starbucks, Steam, Uber Eats, UPS, USPS, Venmo, Verizon, Wells Fargo, Whole Foods, and YouTube Music.

Apple said developers can easily optimize their apps for the iPhone Duo. Apps that use standard SwiftUI and UIKit components adapt automatically to each display, with controls moved to the status bar and multi-column support on the inner display. New APIs let developers optimize their apps for the device's various layouts and poses.
Apple has hosted more than 50 in-person iPhone Duo app workshops in 19 cities worldwide, and there are online resources like the Apple Developer Forums.

In the meantime, apps built with the iOS 27 SDK resize to fill most of the inner display on the iPhone Duo, but they avoid the status bar on the right edge. Apps built with the iOS 26 SDK or earlier run on the iPhone Duo, but appear in the center of the inner display, with lots of empty black space on the left and right sides of the apps.

iPhone Duo app optimization has been a hotly debated topic on social media platforms, with some people pointing out apps that are not yet optimized and others saying the issue is overblown. It is clearly a mixed bag, with some apps optimized and some not. More apps are being updated by the day, though, so the situation is improving rapidly.

units.text: 苹果宣布自折叠屏手机iPhone Duo上市以来，开发者已迅速推进应用适配工作。目前，App Store中已有超过10万款应用针对iPhone Duo完成优化，并且每天仍有数千款新应用加入适配行列。
iPhone Duo正式发货至今约两周时间，应用生态一直被视为外界关注的重点之一。作为苹果首款折叠屏手机，设备采用内外双屏设计，因此应用能否充分利用新的屏幕形态，被认为将直接影响用户体验。
苹果全球开发者关系副总裁苏珊·普雷斯科特表示，开发者对于iPhone Duo的响应速度远超预期。她称，苹果非常高兴看到开发者积极拥抱这一全新产品形态，并对他们展现出的创新能力表示赞赏。目前已经有超过10万款专门针对iPhone Duo打造的应用在App Store上线，而且每天都有大量新应用完成优化更新。

苹果列举了一批近期完成适配的代表性应用，其中包括微软旗下的Word、Excel、OneNote和PowerPoint，以及Zoom、Instagram、WhatsApp、YouTube、Netflix、Amazon Prime Video、Goodnotes、Fantastical、Flighty、Etsy、Halide Mark III、NBA、NHL和SmartGym等知名应用。针对iPhone Duo完成优化的应用，在设备上的App Store页面中还会显示“Made for iPhone Duo”专属标识，方便用户识别。
为了推动开发进度，苹果在过去一个月内于全球19座城市举办了超过50场线下开发者活动，共吸引超过2000名开发者参与。开发者能够亲自体验iPhone Duo硬件，并学习如何针对折叠屏形态设计和优化应用界面。
苹果表示，采用标准SwiftUI和UIKit组件开发的应用能够自动适配内外屏显示环境。与此同时，公司还提供了全新的开发接口，允许开发者针对不同折叠角度、铰链姿态以及多种显示模式创建专属布局，从而进一步发挥折叠屏设备优势。
对于尚未完成优化的旧版应用，系统仍然能够正常运行，但用户体验会受到一定影响。这些应用虽然可以在iPhone Duo上启动，却无法充分利用内部大屏空间，在展开状态下往往无法实现最佳显示效果。
尽管10万款应用这一数字看上去十分可观，但考虑到App Store拥有数百万款应用，仍有大量软件尚未完成适配。一些用户经常使用的应用直到最近才陆续加入支持行列，例如Google Maps不久前才推出针对iPhone Duo的优化版本。
苹果认为，目前应用生态的发展速度仍在不断提升。随着越来越多开发者获得真机测试机会并完成更新，未来数月内将有更多应用充分发挥iPhone Duo折叠屏设计的优势，使用户能够获得更加成熟和完善的使用体验。

units.text: Apple released the iPhone Duo two weeks ago, and the app story is quickly taking shape. In a new statement to 9to5Mac, Apple has revealed that there are already “well over 100,000 apps” on the App Store designed for iPhone Duo, and thousands are being added each day.
Here’s Susan Prescott, Apple’s vice president of Worldwide Developer Relations:

“It’s been wonderful to see how quickly developers have embraced iPhone Duo, and we’re grateful for their creativity and innovation. Today there are well over 100,000 apps built for iPhone Duo already live on the App Store, and thousands of optimized apps are being added to the store each day.

“In the last month alone, thousands of developers have joined us for workshops in 19 cities around the world to experience iPhone Duo firsthand and bring updated apps to their users. The enthusiasm has been incredible, and we’re excited to see the pace of updates continue to accelerate as more and more apps optimize for iPhone Duo.”
In total, Apple says that over 2,000 developers have attended more than 50 in-person workshops around the world.

Apple is continuing to spotlight apps for iPhone Duo on the App Store, including editorial curations like “Popular Apps on iPhone Duo” and “Great Games on iPhone Duo.” There’s also a “Made for iPhone Duo” badge that appears on product pages for apps optimized for Apple’s foldable.
Recent apps optimized for iPhone Duo include Microsoft Word, Microsoft Outlook, Zoom, Etsy, Halide Mark III, and more.

I detailed the iPhone Duo app experience in my full review last month. At the time, I emphasized the big difference between using an app updated for iPhone Duo and one that isn’t. I’m thrilled to see how quickly the apps I use every day are being updated for iPhone Duo.
Another trend I’m noticing is that apps that were quick to support iPhone Duo at launch have since received subsequent updates with better optimization for the inner and outer displays.

units.text: While the illuminated Apple logo on the new MacBook Pro drew one of the biggest cheers during last week’s announcement, Apple knows that not everyone will want to keep it on. Here’s the company’s official guide to turning it off.
How to turn the Apple glowing logo off
The new MacBook Pro with PROLED XDR Display marks the return of the illuminated Apple logo on its lid after a decade.

As Chance Miller explained in his review of the new MacBook Pro, “unlike older MacBooks, which used light from the display’s backlight to illuminate the logo, the new OLED MacBook Pro has no backlight to draw from, requiring a different approach.”

He added that, as with the old Macs, the logo’s brightness is tied to the screen brightness, though it also accounts for overall ambient brightness. He also noted that “when the MacBook Pro is closed, the logo looks like polished metal, just like it has since the 2016 redesign.”
The review echoed some of the findings developer Gui Rambo shared on X a few days ago:

The glowing Apple logo on the new MacBook Pro is controllable by software. It has 25kHz PWM and per-device calibration. CoreBrightness controls the relationship between screen and logo brightness. The brightness of the logo is adjusted differently depending on the enclosure color pic.twitter.com/baqBEkzJUo
— Guilherme Rambo (@_inside) November 4, 2026
Now, Apple has published an official support document that also explains how the illuminated logo works and how to turn it off completely.
Here’s Apple:

The Apple logo behind the built-in display is illuminated whenever the Mac is awake. It automatically dims or brightens based on the brightness level of the built-in screen and the lighting conditions detected by the computer’s ambient light sensor. For all screen-brightness levels, the Apple logo will be dimmer in a dim room and brighter in a bright room.
For users who’d rather keep the logo turned off at all times, Apple explains that they can run the following command in Terminal, provided they have the administrator password:
sudo defaults write com.apple.CoreBrightness LEBacklightMode -int 0
View all comments
To revert the command and have the logo be illuminated again, users will need to run the following command:
sudo defaults delete com.apple.CoreBrightness LEBacklightMode
Apple notes that reinstalling macOS will also turn the logo illumination back on.
To read Apple’s full support article, follow this link. And make sure to also catch 9to5Mac’s review of the new MacBook Pro.

units.text: Once a common sight in lecture theaters and coffee shops everywhere, the glowing emblem of an Apple logo featured on the lids of many Mac laptops launched in the early 2000s. In a nice touch, the new 14-inch and 16-inch MacBook Pro models with PROLED XDR displays bring back the much-loved logo. It's lit up whenever the Mac is awake, and it automatically dims or brightens based on your screen's brightness level and the ambient light in the room.
Image credit: MacRumors forum member sniffies

If you'd rather keep the logo dark, Apple has shared a way to turn it off. Unusually though, there's no switch in System Settings. Instead, you need to enter a command in the Terminal app. If that sounds intimidating, don't worry – it's a single line that you can copy and paste. Note that the following command only works on MacBook Pro models with a PROLED XDR display.
Open Terminal on your Mac: it's in the Applications ➝ Utilities folder, or you can search for "Terminal" using Spotlight (Command + Space).
Type or paste the following command, then press Enter:
sudo defaults write com.apple.CoreBrightness LEBacklightMode -int 0
When prompted, enter your administrator password and press Enter. (Terminal doesn't show the password as you type it.)

After performing the steps, the logo illumination should turn off immediately, no restart required. The change applies to all macOS user accounts on the machine, and it will carry over even if you start up from macOS Recovery. If you later migrate to a new Mac, the setting even transfers across with the rest of your system.
Relight the Apple Logo
Reinstalling macOS turns the illumination back on, but you can also turn it back on yourself at any time by entering the following command in Terminal:
sudo defaults delete com.apple.CoreBrightness LEBacklightMode
Remember to press Enter!
Backstory

The first Mac laptop with a lit-up Apple logo was the third-generation PowerBook G3 launched in 1999. The glowing symbol proved a mainstay through consecutive Apple notebooks for the next 16 years. The only change in that period was that the logo got flipped upright, so that it no longer appeared upside-down to onlookers when someone was sat in public with the lid open.

According to former Apple employee Joe Moreno, the original orientation was deliberate: Apple's design group had found that users kept trying to open their laptops from the wrong end. "Steve Jobs always focused on providing the best possible user experience and believed that it was more important to satisfy the user than the onlooker," Moreno recalled.
Ironically, Jobs later reversed the decision.
"Opening a laptop from the wrong end is a self-correcting problem that only lasts a few seconds," said Moreno. "However, viewing the upside logo is a problem that lasts indefinitely."
The earlier orientation, seen in Sex and the City (Image: HBO/Everett/Rex Features)

In 2015, Apple began nixing the illuminated insignia from its laptops, starting with the ultra-thin 12-inch MacBook, which had a polished metal logo instead, like iPads before it. In 2016, a new generation of MacBook Pro models continued the unlit trend. Apple hasn't launched a Mac laptop with a glowing logo since – until now.

units.text: Apple has returned the glowing white Apple logo to the lid of the new MacBook Pro with PROLED XDR. It's not in Settings, but there's a way to turn it off.
You just can't please people. For ten years we've been denied the once famous glowing logo and as soon as we get it back, there are complaints.

There are people who want the newest iPhones to come in distinctive colors just so that everyone knows they've got the latest one. So you'd think there'd also be people who'd want you to know they've got — and could afford — the new MacBook Pro.

But whether it's they don't want to advertise Apple quite so visibly, or whether they want to pretend to be using Windows laptops, there is a solution. Actually, there are two solutions, where one is Apple just accepting the physics of the situation, and the other is it making you work for what you want.
The simple solution
The logo isn't how it used to be. The old version used the LCD backlight to illuminate a plastic cut out. OLED lighting doesn't work that way.

Instead, the logo is similar to how a smart light works. Brightness is tied to, but not because of, the main screen's brightness. So, Apple has set it up so you can reduce the glow of that literal back light, by dimming the display.
It's definitely a simple way to cut down the glow, but it's unlikely to be practical. You need to set the front screen's brightness to whatever it is you need, you don't want to be peering at it.
So the alternative it is to turn off the glowing logo in software. While that isn't difficult, Apple has no interest in making it a tick box.
Turning off the logo
Instead, as revealed in Apple's support documentation, the way to turn off the logo is to enter a Terminal command. Specifically paste this into Terminal:
sudo defaults write com.apple.CoreBrightness LEBacklightMode -int 0
You'll then be prompted to enter your Mac's password, but as soon as you've done that, the logo is off.
When you realize that you are missing out, though, you can go back to Terminal and instead paste in this:
sudo defaults delete com.apple.CoreBrightness LEBacklightMode
The change is persistent, and will span all accounts on the Mac. Additionally, Apple notes that reinstalling macOS will also re-light the logo.

units.text: IT之家 11 月 6 日消息，苹果公司昨日（11 月 5 日）更新支持文档，指出在配备 PROLED XDR 显示屏的苹果首款触控 MacBook Pro 上，用户可以通过终端（Terminal）命令，彻底关闭 A 面的苹果发光 LOGO。
苹果表示，只要 Mac 处于唤醒状态，内置显示屏背后的苹果 LOGO 就会亮起，其亮度会根据屏幕亮度以及环境光传感器检测到的光线自动调节。在用户感知中，在昏暗房间中这个 LOGO 会更暗，在明亮环境中则会更亮。
开发者和媒体评测还发现，该标志由软件控制，采用 25kHz PWM 调光，并针对每台设备进行校准，系统会依据屏幕与标志亮度的关系，以及不同机身颜色，分别调整发光效果。
IT之家援引博文介绍，如果用户希望彻底关闭发光 Apple 标志，可在“终端”中运行以下命令，并输入管理员密码：
sudo defaults write com.apple.CoreBrightness LEBacklightMode -int 0
若想恢复默认的发光效果，则运行：
sudo defaults delete com.apple.CoreBrightness LEBacklightMode
苹果同时提醒，重新安装 macOS 后，发光 Logo 会重新开启。

units.text: Apple's road to its iconic MacBook was bumpy, and saw oversized portables, colorful clamshells, keyboard issues, and spanned three entirely different chip architectures. Here's a snapshot of 35 years of true Apple portables.
Apple's no slouch when it comes to giving its customers choices. Currently, Apple sells the Mac mini, Mac Studio, iMac, MacBook Neo, MacBook Air, and MacBook Pro.
Depending on when you got into Macs, your iconic machine is either Jobs' original vision, the iMac G3, or more recently, a MacBook of some sort.
Apple didn't nail portable Macs on its first try. It took decades of iterations to bring the PROLED MacBook Pro to fruition.
This isn't everything Apple ever released, but there are some notable models. Here are the notable pit stops Apple made on the way to creating its iconic lineup.
Macintosh Portable (1989-1991)
It was the summer of 1989, and Apple was gearing up to release something big, in both the literal and metaphorical sense: its first portable computer.
Where it all began - the Macintosh Portable.

The Macintosh Portable was far from the first battery-powered "portable" machine; that award actually goes to IBM's 1981 behemoth, the Epson HX-20. Still, the Mac Portable is the humble seed from which future generations of portable Macs would sprout.
Specs at launch:
CPU: Motorola 68000 @ 16 MHz
Memory: 1 MB RAM (expandable to 9 MB)
Storage: 1.44 MB floppy; optional 40 MB SCSI hard drive
Launch Price: $6,500

One of the most impressive feats of late 1980s engineering is that, somehow, the Macintosh Portable managed to get 10 hours of battery life on the non-backlit models with a giant and heavy lead-acid battery. The 2026 MacBook Pro gets up to 24 hours of battery life depending on the task, while the MacBook Air can get a maximum of 18.

The biggest issue, here, is that the Macintosh Portable is demonstrably not portable. Some of our staffers had one, and Mike called it "charitably, a luggable." Weighing in at a whopping 16lbs, it's not something you're going to tuck under your arm and move from room to room with.
Sixteen pounds, for the record, is the weight of two standard US gallons of milk. Or, if you're into bowling, about the weight of a men's bowling ball on the heavier side.
Its excessive weight, coupled with a decidedly large, 15-inch by 15-inch footprint, is probably why it was discontinued a mere two years after its inception.
PowerBook (1991-2006)
Just as the Macintosh Portable was fading in the rearview, Apple released its next attempt at a portable computer: the PowerBook.
The PowerBook was the first of Apple's offerings to truly look like a laptop. It was also truly portable, with the heaviest PowerBook released coming in at a then-scant 6.8 pounds.
Apple's PowerBook 100 - Image Credit: William Gallagher
The PowerBook would see many iterations over its nearly 15-year tenure, including:
PowerBook 100 Series (1991-1995)
Initially released in October 1991, Apple released the entry-level PowerBook 100, a mid-range PowerBook 140, and the PowerBook 170, which was aimed at professionals.
It was also the first of Apple's devices to abandon the company's Snow White design language. Instead, it opted for a darker gray, which Apple deemed sufficiently "corporate."
Specs at launch:
CPU: Motorola 68000 @ 16 MHz
Memory: 2 - 4 MB RAM
Storage: 20 - 80 MB hard drive
Launch Price: Starting at $2,300
The first series PowerBook was immediately successful, and as Low End Mac points out, it dethroned both Compaq and Toshiba in the private market.
PowerBook Duo (1992 - 1997)
The PowerBook Duo made its first appearance in 1992. Designed to be a smaller, lighter, and even more portable machine.
Apple PowerBook Duo 280c - Image Credit: Alexander Schaelss/Wikipedia
There was a tradeoff, though. The PowerBook Duo omitted many features, instead relying on proprietary docking stations that would expand the machine's capabilities.
Specs at launch:
CPU: Motorola 68030 @ 25— 33 MHz
Memory: 4 to 24 MB
Storage: 80 MB to 120 MB hard drive
Launch Price: Starting at $2,300
In 1993, Apple would release the PowerBook 145, PowerBook 160, and PowerBook 180 as an upgrade to the original lineup. The PowerBook 150 would make its debut in the summer of 1994.

Much like everyone else, Apple was feeling pressure to adapt to the aesthetics of the new millennium. In July 1999, Apple would introduce its newest portable and yet again redefine personal computing.
Apple's first iBook, the iBook G3, was notable for a few reasons. The first was its design.
Apple's original iBook - image credit: Apple.

While it certainly wasn't Apple's first blobject, that honor goes to the iMac G3; its Y2K aesthetic made it an instant eye-catcher. Available in tangerine, blueberry, graphite, indigo, and key lime, its rounded clamshell design evoked a more playful take on the personal computer.

While Apple wouldn't keep the design for long, it did actually keep many of the features. This included moving ports from the back to the sides, providing multiple color options, and forgoing latches.
Specs at launch:
CPU: PowerPC G3 (750)
Memory: 32— 544 MB RAM
Storage: 3.2— 6 GB hard drive
Launch Price: Starting at $1,599
PowerBook G4 (2001-2006)
The PowerBook would get its next major refresh in 2001 with the introduction of the PowerBook G4. This would be the first of Apple's laptops that resembled anything that they sold going forward.
PowerBook G4 - Image Credit: Jared C. Benefict/Wikipedia
Specs at launch:
CPU: PowerPC 7410
Memory: 128MB-1GB
Storage: 10GB-30GB
Launch Price: Starting at $1,599
Its sleek design was available in silver, a color that would quickly become a signature of Apple. It was also notably thin, especially when compared to other machines available on the market.
It was also Apple's first laptop to feature an "upright" orientation of the Apple logo. Previous iterations of the logo would appear upside down to onlookers.
It wouldn't be until April 2006 that Apple would finally release its first MacBook. Its primary audience was the average user, especially those in education.
Specs at launch:
CPU: Yonah Intel Core Duo (T2400)
Memory: 512 MB - 4 GB
Storage: 60 - 120 GB
Launch Price: Starting at $1,099

A notable trait of the original MacBook is that it initially launched in a polycarbonate shell. It was initially available in white and black, but in 2008, Apple released an aluminum version and discontinued the black plastic MacBook.
The polycarbonate MacBook - Image Credit: Apple

True to Apple's form at the time, it kept the ports on the side. Left side ports included the MagSafe power connector, Ethernet, Mini DisplayPort, 2 USB 2.0 ports, 3.5mm audio out, and a Kensington security slot. On the right was the device's optical drive.
The original MacBook enjoyed a six-year tenure before it was discontinued in 2012.
MacBook Pro (Circa early 2006)

Apple also launched its first MacBook Pro in 2006 as an Intel-based replacement for its PowerBook lineup. It realized that the market likely had enough room to differentiate between the average and professional-grade laptop computers.
MacBook Pro from 2006 - Image Credit: Apple

It came with an aluminum chassis, which helped to drive home the fact that this was for professionals, rather than its entry-level counterpart. It was available in two screen sizes: 13-inch and 17-inch.
Specs at launch:
CPU: Intel Core Duo Yonah
Memory: 512 MB
Storage: 80GB
Launch Price: Starting at $1,900
Reception was mostly positive, with reviewers especially impressed by the screen's brightness and viewing angles. They also appreciated the new MagSafe power adapter.
The main criticisms of the MacBook Pro were its underclocked memory and its propensity to run hot. Apple would address these issues in subsequent releases.
MacBook Air (Circa 2008)

For many Apple enthusiasts, and even many outsiders, the MacBook Air is possibly the most iconic Apple reveal of all time. Steve Jobs introduced it at the 2008 Macworld conference when he pulled it from a manila envelope.
MacBook Air from 2009 - Image Credit: Apple
The portability factor has made it a great go-to for workers who demand a portable setup, as well as college students.
Specs at launch:
CPU: Merom Intel Core 2 Duo
Memory: 2GB
Storage: 60 - 80 GB
Launch Price: Starting at $1,799
The MacBook Air would eventually become Apple's most popular computer. It is often many people's introductory Mac.
Apple periodically over-specced the MacBook Air for what an average user needed. This leads to users often keeping the same MacBook for years, with an average lifespan of five to seven years.
MacBook Pro with Touch Bar (circa 2016)
It would be remiss of us not to talk about Apple's MacBook Pro that featured the Touch Bar and that notorious Butterfly Keyboard.
Apple released the MacBook Pro with Touch Bar in 2016. It opted to remove the function button row and replace it with a thin, long touch-sensitive screen that adapted across applications.
A MacBook Pro with a Touch Bar - Image Credit: Apple

For example, the bar could be used to control volume and skip forward or back when listening to movies. If the user switched to a program like Photoshop, the bar may adapt individually for tools like altering an image's hues and levels.
In practice, it was awkward for most. Even fans lamented the loss of physical function keys.
Base-level specs at launch
CPU: 2.9 GHz Core i5
Memory: 8GB
Storage: 256 - 512 GB
Launch Price: Starting at $1,799
The butterfly keyboard was a saga all of its own, leading to a years-long repair program.
M1 MacBook Air
On November 10, 2020, Apple announced the all-new M1 MacBook Air. It would be the first of Apple's computers to use a custom ARM-based Apple Silicon processor.
M1 MacBook Air - Image Credit: Apple
It featured a fanless design, only made possible by the energy efficiency of the new M1 chip. It also featured support for Thunderbolt 3/USB 4 and a wide color (P3) display.
Base-level specs at launch
CPU: Apple M1
Memory: 8GB - 16 GB
Storage: 128 GB - 2 TB
Launch price: Starting at $799

Reception was positive, with reviewers and customers praising the performance capabilities of Apple Silicon. The lack of a fan, as well as the keyboard and trackpad, were also cited as standout design elements.

The largest criticism the device received was its external display support. Its predecessor, the final Intel-based MacBook Air, could support two external displays; the M1 MacBook Air could only support one.
Still, the MacBook Air proved that Apple was more than capable when it came to designing its own processors. And, as such, it would forge a path forward without Intel.
Apple would begin adding Silicon to its entire Mac lineup over a period of two years. The final Intel-based Mac was fully discontinued in 2023, when Apple stopped selling the Mac Pro.
MacBook Neo

Apple has posited the MacBook Neo as the perfect introductory Mac. It's been pitched as the ideal machine for someone who can't quite get by with an iPad but may not need the more robust mid-level MacBook Air.
Effectively, it's been designed to fill the hole that the 12-inch MacBook left when it was discontinued in 2017.
MacBook Neo

It's most notable for being the first of Apple's MacBook lineup to rely on an A-series "mobile" chip. It makes it ideal for younger users, casual users, and users who may already have a higher-end Mac mini or Mac Studio setup, but would like something portable.
CPU: A18 Pro
Memory: 8GB
Storage: 256 - 512 GB
Price at launch: Starting at $599

Before its official sales date, the MacBook Neo was heavily criticized. There were claims that there would be no audience for a laptop with a mobile chip, mostly from people who didn't understand Apple Silicon engineering. Apple proved them wrong.
The MacBook Neo has seen great success. So much so that Apple had a difficult time keeping them in stock.
PROLED MacBook Pro
And now we come to today.
After years of rumors, Apple has brought OLED to the MacBook Pro. Officially called the MacBook Pro with PROLED XDR Display, the new lineup comes in 14-inch and 16-inch sizes.

Its most notable upgrade is the tandem OLED screen, which delivers deeper blacks, higher contrast, and brighter HDR highlights. It also makes these the first MacBooks with touchscreen support, bringing multitouch gestures and touch-friendly controls to macOS.
CPU: M5 Pro or M5 Max
Memory: Starting at 24GB with M5 Pro or 36GB with M5 Max
Storage: Up to 16TB
Price at launch: Starting at $2,899
The new models retain the same processors and physical dimensions as their non-OLED counterparts, but are lighter and replace the display notch with a smaller Dynamic Island.
OLED MacBook Pro

Apple is keeping the non-OLED models in the lineup, positioning the new versions as a premium option for users who want the upgraded display and touch support. Both sizes are scheduled to begin shipping on November 6, 2026.
It will be hard to tell how the OLED MacBook Pro performs. Apple had, for years, sworn to never make a touchscreen MacBook, as the ergonomics did not make any sense.
That, coupled with the nearly $3,000 entry price, could make it a tough sell. Or, like many Apple products, it may prove its worth in the lineup.

units.text: I love natural gas heat for a few reasons, but one is avoiding AUX heat from a heat pump and watching the bill rise. The downside is when the gas heat kicks on, the air in mt house is bone dry. My nose ends up being super dry for months. A humidifier like the Airversa Humelle works with Apple Home over Thread, so it can run itself based on what the air actually needs, and with the temps in my area getting into the 40s in the next week, I am glad I have one.
HomeKit Weekly is a series focused on smart home accessories, automation tips and tricks, and everything to do with Apple’s smart home framework.

The Airversa Humelle humidifier uses Thread, so it does join your existing Thread network via a HomePod, HomePod mini, or Apple TV 4K and communicates with Apple Home locally. In my experience, Thread accessories always respond faster and drop connections less than Wi-Fi-only ones, and they don’t add to the pile of devices fighting for airtime on your router either. Especially since most smart home devices are 2.4 GHz only.

Once the Airversa Humelle is paired with Apple Home, it appears in the Home app as a humidifier with a built-in temperature and humidity sensor. The latter sensor is the key for automations as well. You can set a target humidity level, and in Auto Mode, it ramps the mist up or down on its own to hold that number. For most people, that’s all the automation they’ll ever need. Set it to 45%, and it’ll run forever. By including that sensor in the device, you don’t need to pair it with a separate Apple Home-compatible humidity sensor for the automations. In fact, that is probably the only automation to run with this device.
Airversa Humelle hardware

The Humelle has a 3.2L tank that Airversa rates at up to 60 hours of runtime, and the mist reaches about 40 inches high, so it covers a bedroom or an average-sized living room pretty easily. It’s a top-fill design, which honestly is the only way these should be made at this point. Flipping them over always ends with some water on the floor.

Sleep Mode runs at 28dB, which is good for a baby’s room, etc. There’s a multicolor LED on the base that you can set to whatever color you want from the Home app or the Sleekpoint app, or turn off completely. There’s also a tray for essential oils if you want it to double as a diffuser to improve a room’s smell.

One thing to know about the Airversa Humelle going in: you’ll still want the Sleekpoint app for a few things, like setting a cleaning reminder that pings you when it’s time to rinse the tank. Day-to-day control lives in Apple Home, but the setup and maintenance features live in the manufacturer’s app. That’s just where Matter is as a protocol right now.
Wrap up on Airversa Humelle

Natural gas heat dries out your inside air, and the Airversa Humelle fixes it. It allows me to avoid regretting my heating choice when I built my house. A humidifier that knows when the air is dry and turns on is the secret sauce. The Humelle does that in Apple Home with Thread, giving you a humidity sensor you can build the rest of your winter automations around. If you need a Thread Border Router, one of the new HomePod mini 2 units is the best to get started.
The Airversa Humelle is available on Amazon and directly from Airversa.

Day-to-day control lives in Apple Home, but the setup and maintenance features live in the manufacturer’s app. That’s just where Matter is as a protocol right now.

Natural gas heat dries out your inside air, and the Airversa Humelle fixes it. It allows me to avoid regretting my heating choice when I built my house. A humidifier that knows when the air is dry and turns on is the secret sauce. The Humelle does that in Apple Home with Thread, giving you a humidity sensor you can build the rest of your winter automations around. If you need a Thread Border Router, one of the new HomePod mini 2 units is the best to get started.

units.text: IT之家 11 月 6 日消息，根据美国证券交易委员会 11 月 5 日披露的初步招股说明书，苹果计划发行七期债券，市场预计融资规模约为 70 亿美元（IT之家注：现汇率约合 467.78 亿元人民币）。
彭博社昨日曾爆料苹果时隔一年半重返债券市场，所得资金将用于回购股票、派发股息等，而目前该消息已得到确认。这将是该公司自 2025 年 5 月融资 45 亿美元（现汇率约合 300.71 亿元人民币）以来首次发行债券，若最终规模达到 70 亿美元（现汇率约合 467.78 亿元人民币），将比上一轮多出 25 亿美元（现汇率约合 167.06 亿元人民币）。
此次拟发行债券包括两只浮动利率票据和五只固定利率票据，到期时间从 2028 年一直延伸至 2036 年。浮动利率票据的利率与担保隔夜融资利率（SOFR）挂钩，每季度调整；固定利率票据则每年付息两次。高盛、美国银行证券、德意志银行证券和摩根大通担任承销机构。
苹果表示，募集资金将用于一般公司用途，包括股票回购、派发股息、营运资金、资本支出、收购以及偿还既有债务，但未披露各项用途的具体金额。

值得注意的是，苹果并不缺乏现金。公司最新财报显示，其 9 月季度营收达 1,145 亿美元（现汇率约合 7,651.49 亿元人民币），运营现金流为 280 亿美元（现汇率约合 1,871.11 亿元人民币）；2026 财年末，苹果持有现金、现金等价物及有价证券合计 1,369 亿美元（现汇率约合 9,148.38 亿元人民币），全年自由现金流约 1,361 亿美元（现汇率约合 9,094.92 亿元人民币）。

科技媒体 AppleInsider 解读认为此次举债更像是财务策略，苹果在 2026 财年回购了 858 亿美元（现汇率约合 5,733.61 亿元人民币）股票，并支付 157 亿美元（现汇率约合 1,049.16 亿元人民币）股息及股息等价物，同时还在 4 月批准了最高 1,000 亿美元（现汇率约合 6,682.52 亿元人民币）的新回购计划。通过低成本发债，苹果可在继续回报股东的同时，保留现金储备，用于未来投资或应对市场变化。
苹果未来一年约有 100 亿美元（现汇率约合 668.25 亿元人民币）债券本金到期，另有 20 亿美元（现汇率约合 133.65 亿元人民币）短期商业票据待偿。新债券也可能被用于债务再融资，帮助公司优化到期结构、降低集中偿付压力。

units.text: Next year Apple is rumored to have a big redesign coming to the iPhone Pro models, and per a new leak, it may come with the loss of the Action button.
Action button reportedly being dropped from iPhone Pro next year for 20th anniversary redesign

2027 brings the iPhone’s 20th anniversary, and all signs indicate Apple has something special planned. Similar to the debut of iPhone X for the 10th anniversary in 2017, Apple may introduce a bold new iPhone design next year.
New iPhone Pro models are rumored to get quad-curved displays that wrap around the edges for a visually bezel-free appearance. Screen size is expected to increase too.
Now today, a new post from leaker Instant Digital on Weibo says this new design will also come with a loss.
Per the post, the Action button will be removed from next year’s iPhone Pro models. The devices will retain a Camera Control button though, similar to iPhone Duo.
View all comments

The leaker says the Action button’s functionality won’t be lost altogether, though. Instead, he says Camera Control will continue to launch the Camera app with a standard press, but a long-press will offer Action button-like functionality.

When iPhone Duo dropped the Action button, some users expressed disappointment that the button’s versatility was lost. Our own Chance Miller, for example, said he would gladly give up Camera Control to keep the Action button.
It sounds like Apple plans to integrate the two, a pattern that will likely apply to the next-generation iPhone Duo and other future models too.
What do you think of Apple’s reported plan for the Action button? Let us know in the comments.

evidence.discovery_lead: IT之家 11 月 6 日消息，博主 @刹那数码 今日发文透露，苹果 Action Button 操作按钮， 将在明年下半年的新款 iPhone 上正式退幕 。 博主称，该按键将与相机按钮进行整合 —— 单击进入相机，长按 Action Button 操作 。 IT之家注：苹果公司自 2007 年推出初代 iPhone 以来，过去的硬件产品更迭中，始终保留了静音拨片，而在 2023 年发布的 iPhone 15 Pro 系列中，静音拨片退出舞台，改用操作按钮。苹果官方对这项功能的描述如下： 在 iPhone 15 Pro 和 iPhone 15 Pro Max 上，操作按钮取代了响铃 / 静音开关。你可以选取按下操作按钮时想要其执行的功能。由于该按钮触手可及，将其用于经常执行的操作会十分有用。（操作按钮的位置如下所示。）想要将其用于其他功能时，你可以轻松地更改操作。 而在 2024 年的 iPhone 16 系列上，苹果又带来了全新的相机控制按键，其具有触觉反馈功能，点击即可启动相机应用程序。再次点击可拍摄照片，而按住不放则可录制视频。还支持触摸手势，可以区分点击和轻按。该按键也一直延续至最新的 18 Pro 系列。 值得一提的是，在 iPhone Duo 上，苹果率先取消了操作按钮。作为参考，苹果此前在 iPhone 6s 上推出过 3D Touch 功能，该功能一直延续至 iPhone XS，但却在同代的 iPhone XR 上直接取消，且后续机型也并未搭载。此次 iPhone Duo 取消 Action Button 操作按钮或暗示后续机型也会取消该按键。 事实上，Action Button 操作按钮与相机控制按键确实在功能性上存在一定重叠 —— 例如，操作按钮设置为快捷打开相机后，支持长按唤醒相机、点按拍照；相机控制按键支持设置单击或双击启动相机 App，进入相机后支持点按拍照。 虽然在 iPhone 15 Pro 推出了操作按钮，方便用户设置不同功能，但依旧有用户选择将其设置为静音键。如果此次爆料属实，意味着陪伴了用户近 20 年的快捷静音操作将彻底退出历史的舞台。 博主 @刹那数码 今日发文透露，苹果 Action Button 操作按钮，将在明年下半年的新款 iPhone 上正式退幕。博主称，该按键将与相机按钮进行整合 —— 单击进入相机，长按 Action Button 操作。#苹果iPhone# #ActionButton#

units.text: The Action Button may soon be dropped, but if you thought that would mean getting back the much-missed mute switch, think again.

Back in 2023, the Action Button began replacing the mute switch on ever iPhones, but that stopped with the launch of the iPhone Duo. Now prolific leaker Instant Digital claims that it's about to be history.

Writing on the Chinese social media site Weibo, they say (in translation) that "Apple's Action button... will officially be phased out starting with new iPhone models in the second half of next year." So presuming Apple sticks to its new split iPhone launch, that may mean that the 20th anniversary iPhone will be the first to lose it.
"It will be integrated with the camera button," the leaker continues. "Tap to launch the camera, press and hold... to perform [the Action Button's] function."
The camera button referred to is presumably the iPhone's Camera Control. This already launches the camera with one tap, but pressing longer is already a way to use Visual Intelligence.
If correct, the Action Button would be the first iPhone control to be removed since that button replaced the mute switch.

While it's unusual for Apple to do this, the company must know how much or how little it is used. Whatever the figures are, they weren't high enough to make finding space for the Action Button on the iPhone Duo a priority.

Then there is also that the button and what its settings are hasn't been significantly updated since launch. There is still the peculiar design that pressing it once does nothing but display a notice telling you to press longer.

Nonetheless, pressing and holding has proved a quick enough way to launch one action or, via Shortcuts, multiple ones. But, speaking of Shortcuts, it is already possible to emulate practically every benefit of the Action Button with a lock screen icon.
The Action Button was first introduced on the Apple Watch Ultra.
Note that Weibo leakers do not have a great track record. Instant Digital has sometimes posted what seems more like wishful thinking than an actual leak.
Even so, removing the Action Button does seem plausible given its absence on the iPhone Duo.
Apple had hopes for the Action Button

The Action Button first appeared on the Apple Watch Ultra back in September 2022. Then it came to the iPhone with the iPhone 15 Pro the following year and the smart money would've bet on it coming to the iPad eventually.
It never did, but Apple certainly had more plans for the Action Button, at least at one stage.
In 2024, for instance, a patent revealed that there could even be more than one Action Button, albeit on iPhone cases instead of the device itself.

units.text: Apple Rumored to Drop the iPhone's Action Button Next Year
Apple plans to merge the iPhone's Action button with the Camera Control starting next year, according to the leaker known as "Instant Digital."

In a new post on Weibo, the leaker claimed that a single press of the combined button would open the camera, while a long press would trigger the function assigned to the Action button. They explicitly clarified that the dedicated Action button would disappear, while the Camera Control button would remain.

The proposed arrangement seems plausible given how the two features already work. The Action button predates the Camera Control and requires a long press to activate its assigned function, while a single press of the Camera Control opens the camera. Combining them in the way described would therefore preserve both familiar interactions, with the customizable action simply moving to a different location on the device.

A long press of Camera Control currently opens Visual Intelligence, but that feature has since been integrated directly into the Camera app as Siri mode in iOS 27. That integration could give Apple room to reassign the gesture while keeping Visual Intelligence accessible through the Camera app.

It is notable that the iPhone Duo also lacks an Action button, despite retaining Camera Control. Its omission provides a precedent for an iPhone without the separate control and could hint at a broader change in the future.

The Camera Control received a mixed reception when it debuted on the iPhone 16, with some reviewers criticizing its usefulness, complexity, and ergonomics, making further refinement seem plausible. Combining it with the Action button could give the control a clearer sense of purpose. Removing a separate button could also simplify manufacturing and reduce the potential for users to confuse the Action button with the adjacent volume buttons.

Apple was previously rumored to be working on a simplified Camera Control design for the iPhone 18 lineup, but that change did not materialize. Instant Digital claimed Apple would remove the capacitive sensing layer and rely on pressure sensing to reduce costs while retaining its functions.
The ‌iPhone 16‌'s Camera Control button.

The latest rumor raises the possibility that a redesign is still in development, potentially as part of a broader rethink that incorporates the Action button's functionality, although it remains unclear whether the two claims describe related plans.

Apple introduced the Action button on the iPhone 15 Pro in 2023 as a replacement for the longstanding Ring/Silent switch. It can be assigned to functions such as Silent mode, Focus, the flashlight, Shortcuts, and more. The rumored combined control would retain a dedicated way to trigger those actions while reducing the number of physical buttons.

Instant Digital said that the change will take place starting with new iPhone models released in the second half of 2027. The claimed timing would presumably coincide with the launch of Apple's 20th-anniversary iPhone models in the fall of next year. Apple's naming plans remain unclear, so the devices could be called the "iPhone 19 Pro," "iPhone 20 Pro," or something else.

units.text: 苹果可能正在重新调整iPhone机身侧面的实体按键设计。根据最新爆料，苹果计划从2027年下半年推出的新款iPhone开始，取消目前独立设置的操作按钮（Action Button），将其功能整合到相机控制按钮（Camera Control）之中。
这一消息来自微博知名爆料人士刹那数码。他透露，苹果正在考虑让原本承担不同功能的两个实体按键合二为一，通过不同的按压方式实现相应操作。
按照爆料描述，整合后的按钮将保留相机控制键的位置，但同时承担原有操作按钮的功能。用户单击按钮即可启动相机，而长按则可以触发此前分配给操作按钮的自定义功能。
这意味着，用户仍然可以通过实体按键快速开启静音模式、专注模式、手电筒、快捷指令等功能，只是操作入口将从原来的独立按钮转移到相机控制键上。
从交互逻辑来看，这种设计并非完全没有依据。目前iPhone的操作按钮本身就需要通过长按才能触发预设功能，而相机控制键则可以通过单击快速启动相机。将两种操作方式整合在同一个按键上，理论上能够保留原有功能，同时减少机身侧面的实体按键数量。
苹果于2023年在iPhone 15 Pro系列上首次引入操作按钮，用它取代沿用了多年的静音拨片。与传统静音开关不同，操作按钮可以由用户自行指定功能，除了切换静音状态，还能够启动相机、手电筒、语音备忘录、翻译以及各种快捷指令。
一年之后，苹果又在iPhone 16系列上推出了相机控制键。这是一枚集成触控和压力感应能力的实体按键，用户可以通过轻按、滑动等操作调整相机参数，也可以直接启动相机。
不过，相机控制键推出后一直存在一定争议。部分用户认为它的操作逻辑比较复杂，实际使用频率不高，而且按键位置容易在握持手机时被误触。相比之下，操作按钮的功能更加直观，也更容易融入日常使用习惯。
如果苹果真的将两者合并，可能也是希望为相机控制键赋予更多实用价值，避免它仅仅成为一个使用场景相对有限的专用按键。
值得注意的是，苹果此前还被曝正在考虑简化相机控制键的内部结构。相关传闻称，公司可能取消原有的电容感应层，改用压力感应技术实现主要操作功能，以降低制造成本，同时保留核心使用体验。
不过，这项简化设计此前并未在iPhone 18系列上实现。此次操作按钮与相机控制键合并的传闻，可能意味着苹果仍在探索对这一实体按键进行更大幅度的重新设计，但目前尚不能确认两项调整是否属于同一套设计方案。
另一个值得关注的细节是，苹果首款折叠屏手机iPhone Duo已经没有独立的操作按钮，但仍然保留了相机控制键。这也为未来取消独立操作按钮提供了一个先例。
按照爆料人士的说法，这项变化预计从2027年下半年发布的新款iPhone开始实施，时间上可能与苹果iPhone问世20周年纪念机型的发布周期重合。届时新机究竟会命名为iPhone 19 Pro、iPhone 20 Pro，还是采用其他名称，目前仍不清楚。
当然，这一消息目前仍属于供应链和爆料人士提供的非官方信息，苹果尚未对此作出确认。
从产品设计趋势来看，苹果似乎正在重新审视iPhone实体按键的数量和功能分配。操作按钮虽然提供了较高的自定义自由度，但独立设置一个按键也占用了机身空间；相机控制键则拥有更复杂的感应结构，如果能够承担更多系统级操作，或许可以提高其实际利用率。
不过，合并之后也会带来一个问题：用户需要记住不同按压方式所对应的功能，长按启动自定义操作与单击启动相机之间是否会产生误触，仍需要苹果通过软件和硬件设计加以解决。
如果这项调整最终落地，操作按钮作为iPhone独立实体按键的历史可能只有短短四年。苹果并非简单地取消自定义快捷功能，而是试图将其融入一个用途更加广泛的实体控制键之中。

从交互逻辑来看，这种设计并非完全没有依据。目前iPhone的操作按钮本身就需要通过长按才能触发预设功能，而相机控制键则可以通过单击快速启动相机。将两种操作方式整合在同一个按键上，理论上能够保留原有功能，同时减少机身侧面的实体按键数量。
苹果于2023年在iPhone 15 Pro系列上首次引入操作按钮，用它取代沿用了多年的静音拨片。与传统静音开关不同，操作按钮可以由用户自行指定功能，除了切换静音状态，还能够启动相机、手电筒、语音备忘录、翻译以及各种快捷指令。
一年之后，苹果又在iPhone 16系列上推出了相机控制键。这是一枚集成触控和压力感应能力的实体按键，用户可以通过轻按、滑动等操作调整相机参数，也可以直接启动相机。
不过，相机控制键推出后一直存在一定争议。部分用户认为它的操作逻辑比较复杂，实际使用频率不高，而且按键位置容易在握持手机时被误触。相比之下，操作按钮的功能更加直观，也更容易融入日常使用习惯。
值得注意的是，苹果此前还被曝正在考虑简化相机控制键的内部结构。相关传闻称，公司可能取消原有的电容感应层，改用压力感应技术实现主要操作功能，以降低制造成本，同时保留核心使用体验。
不过，这项简化设计此前并未在iPhone 18系列上实现。此次操作按钮与相机控制键合并的传闻，可能意味着苹果仍在探索对这一实体按键进行更大幅度的重新设计，但目前尚不能确认两项调整是否属于同一套设计方案。
按照爆料人士的说法，这项变化预计从2027年下半年发布的新款iPhone开始实施，时间上可能与苹果iPhone问世20周年纪念机型的发布周期重合。届时新机究竟会命名为iPhone 19 Pro、iPhone 20 Pro，还是采用其他名称，目前仍不清楚。
从产品设计趋势来看，苹果似乎正在重新审视iPhone实体按键的数量和功能分配。操作按钮虽然提供了较高的自定义自由度，但独立设置一个按键也占用了机身空间；相机控制键则拥有更复杂的感应结构，如果能够承担更多系统级操作，或许可以提高其实际利用率。
不过，合并之后也会带来一个问题：用户需要记住不同按压方式所对应的功能，长按启动自定义操作与单击启动相机之间是否会产生误触，仍需要苹果通过软件和硬件设计加以解决。
如果这项调整最终落地，操作按钮作为iPhone独立实体按键的历史可能只有短短四年。苹果并非简单地取消自定义快捷功能，而是试图将其融入一个用途更加广泛的实体控制键之中。

units.text: Apple shared a new Apple Card ad on its YouTube page today featuring a therapist who realizes she really needs a vacation. Watch it below.
Apple shares funny Apple Card ad
In a new ad shared today, Apple showcases how easy it is to apply for an Apple Card and start using it right away.
The ad shows a therapist who gets distracted mid-session by a notification about a flash sale on flights to Jamaica on her iPhone, but realizes her wallet is too far away to act on it.
As her patient continues talking about his problems, she quickly applies for an Apple Card through the Wallet app and uses it to book the flight, all without him noticing, but just barely.
The video description reads:

Apple Card is is [sic] built into iPhone, and you can apply in as little as a minute. No waiting for a physical credit card, no friction. All it takes is a few taps of your iPhone. You can earn unlimited daily cash back, and use it right away.

Apple’s latest Apple Card ad comes as the company kicks off its holiday shopping season today, with festive decorations arriving at its physical and online stores, along with an extended return policy for holiday purchases.

Apple today also launched its new OLED iPad mini, M6-powered iMac and MacBook Pro, along with the redesigned MacBook Pro featuring an OLED touchscreen, and is just days away from releasing the long-awaited Apple HomeView smart display.

evidence.discovery_title: 淘宝 MNN 团队开源 0.3B 手机模型，苹果 iPhone 18 Pro 离线跑出 350 token/s
evidence.raw_lead: 淘宝旗下 MNN 团队今日发布了 MNN-Pocket-0.3B 模型，面向手机应用的任务需求与资源预算，在有限算力、内存和能耗下，兼顾任务能力、响应速度与持续运行体验。
evidence.title: 淘宝 MNN 团队开源 0.3B 手机模型，苹果 iPhone 18 Pro 离线跑出 350 token/s

units.text: IT之家 11 月 6 日消息，淘宝旗下 MNN 团队今日发布了 MNN-Pocket-0.3B 模型，面向手机应用的任务需求与资源预算，在有限算力、内存和能耗下，兼顾任务能力、响应速度与持续运行体验。
围绕淘宝等综合型手机应用，团队将“手机应用原生大模型”落实为四个维度的设计目标：
速度上，在指定设备与上下文配置下，解码吞吐超过 200token/s。这一目标参考高速云端模型服务的生成吞吐，力求在本地提供流畅的生成体验。
内存上，在指定测试条件下，峰值内存低于 300MB。即使手机拥有 8～16GB 内存，也需要由系统与多个应用共享。以约 500MB 的模型模块预算为例，将推理峰值控制在 300MB 以下，可以为上下文增长和集成开销保留余量。
功耗上，在典型推理负载（输入 512~1024token、输出 128token）下，单次推理增量能耗目标不超过参考手机电池能量的万分之一，即 100 次推理耗能不超过电池能总量的 1%，控制高频调用的续航开销。
能力上，以在指定业务场景上达到 8B 级模型的效果为目标，兼顾中英文理解、世界知识与数学、代码推理能力，重点强化指令遵循，并为长上下文与多步骤任务保留扩展空间。
MNN 团队从零设计并训练了这个约 3 亿参数、重点支持中文与英文的轻量语言模型，将模型结构、词表、训练数据、预训练与后训练方法，以及量化和推理引擎纳入协同优化，为淘宝业务与开源社区开发者提供一个具备任务理解能力、响应迅速、易于适配和集成的模型底座。
MNN-Pocket-0.3B 在苹果 iPhone 18 Pro 上的真机表现实测，模型通过 MNN 推理引擎完全离线运行，平均解码（Decode）速度约为 350token/s。
MNN-Pocket-0.3B 的 INT4 MNN 部署文件体积仅为 173MB，包含模型权重、分词器、计算图和推理配置。
在 iPad Pro M5、Metal 后端、512token 测试配置下，模型加载与推理期间的峰值 Metal 驻留内存相对加载前基线增加 228MB。
同一测试中，Qwen3-0.6B 的部署文件体积为 340MB，峰值内存增量为 427MB。相比之下，MNN-Pocket-0.3B 的部署体积减少约 49%，峰值内存增量减少约 47%。
对于手机应用原生大模型，较小的部署体积能够降低模型下载与更新成本，较低的运行内存则为页面、图片、视频等业务模块保留更多空间，降低应用集成的资源负担。
团队在苹果与 Android 设备上，使用 Metal、OpenCL 和 CPU 后端评估推理吞吐。测试采用 MNN 3.6.2、INT4 量化及统一运行设置，每组配置预热一次、测量五次，取吞吐中位数，Prefill 与 Decode 分别测量。
在 iPad Pro M5/Metal、512token 测试配置下，MNN-Pocket-0.3B 的 Prefill 吞吐达到 8,721token/s，Decode 吞吐达到 466token/s，约为同条件下 Qwen3-0.6B（286token/s）的 1.63 倍。在 Snapdragon 8 Gen 5 的 CPU 后端，Decode 吞吐达到 251token/s。
面向手机应用原生大模型，团队将峰值内存低于 300MB、解码吞吐高于 200token/s 作为架构选型目标，在资源预算内尽可能保留模型容量。围绕这一目标，团队构建了覆盖约 50M 至 1.3B 参数的稠密（Dense）模型配置，在 iPad Pro M5、统一推理设置下进行测试。约 300M 是该组实验中同时满足两项约束的最大候选规模。
确定规模后，团队进一步在相近参数预算内，联合调整模型深度、隐藏层宽度、前馈网络与注意力配置。从 16 层增加到 28 层带来了能力提升；继续增加到 36 层，评测均分没有进一步提高，解码吞吐却从 355token/s 降至 323token/s。这里的吞吐用于架构选型对比，与前述最终部署版本的测试配置不同。
最终，MNN-Pocket-0.3B 采用 28 层结构，结合分组查询注意力（GQA）等配置，在模型能力、运行内存与推理效率之间取得平衡。
面向中文互联网手机应用，MNN-Pocket-0.3B 将中文与英文作为重点支持语言，降低对其他语言分词效率的优先级。基于 Qwen3 分词器，团队将词表从约 151K 精简至 64K，词条数量缩减约 57%，减少词嵌入与输出层的参数和存储需求，并降低逐 Token 生成时的输出投影开销。

在能耗方面，团队还在一加 13（骁龙 8 至尊版）上，使用 MNN 对 MNN-Pocket-0.3B 的 4-bit 模型进行了功耗测试。在 CPU4 线程、输入 1024 和输出 128 基准负载下，通过采集电池电流与电压，并扣除闲置基准耗电，三轮测试折算的平均增量能耗约为 2.7J / 轮。以该手机电池容量 6000mAh 计算，执行 100 次同等负载任务累计增量能耗约占电池总电量的 0.3%。
模型能力方面，在技术报告采用的评测设置下，MNN-Pocket-0.3B 的英文 IFEval 得分为 73.20，团队构建的中文指令遵循 IFEval-zh 得分为 74.59，在所比较模型中均取得最高分。
在覆盖中英文知识、推理、数学、代码与指令遵循的 11 项评测中，模型平均得分达到 50.00，高于报告列出的同规模模型，以及 MiniCPM4-0.5B、Qwen3-0.6B 等更大规模的对比模型。其中，中文数学 MGSM-zh 得分为 51.20，代码生成 HumanEval 得分为 53.66。
手机应用原生大模型的价值，还需要通过任务适配与应用集成来验证。为此，MNN-Pocket-0.3B 提供了从预训练、后训练到端侧部署的多个版本，让研究者与开发者能够选择合适的起点，继续训练、评测和构建应用。

MNN 团队从零设计并训练了这个约 3 亿参数、重点支持中文与英文的轻量语言模型，将模型结构、词表、训练数据、预训练与后训练方法，以及量化和推理引擎纳入协同优化，为淘宝业务与开源社区开发者提供一个具备任务理解能力、响应迅速、易于适配和集成的模型底座。
MNN-Pocket-0.3B 在苹果 iPhone 18 Pro 上的真机表现实测，模型通过 MNN 推理引擎完全离线运行，平均解码（Decode）速度约为 350token/s。
MNN-Pocket-0.3B 的 INT4 MNN 部署文件体积仅为 173MB，包含模型权重、分词器、计算图和推理配置。

units.text: IT之家 11 月 6 日消息，集邦咨询（TrendForce）综合 ZDNet、第一财经及《韩国先驱报》等多家媒体报道，称三星电子与苹果正与供应链合作研发一种新型超薄玻璃（UTG）方案，目标在 2028 年用于折叠屏手机，在保持可弯折的同时显著提升屏幕抗刮与表面硬度。
IT之家援引博文介绍，该方案主打“差异化厚度”，对屏幕中央折叠区进行蚀刻，让其保持约 40 微米的超薄状态；而非折叠区域则保留超过 100 微米的较厚玻璃，从而兼顾柔韧性与耐用性。
集邦咨询指出当前折叠屏普遍采用厚度均匀的 UTG 盖板，虽然能够实现反复弯折，但整体较薄，表面硬度与抗刮能力相对受限。若新技术落地，手机屏幕最易被钥匙、沙粒划伤的两侧区域将拥有更强保护，而真正需要弯折的中缝仍可保持轻薄。
不过，该技术商业化落地依然存在诸多挑战，其中的关键难点是为了确保蚀刻区域光学特性与周边玻璃一致，需要填充合适材料，否则屏幕可能出现可见色差或观感不均。
当前三星 Galaxy Z Fold8 Ultra、Z Fold8 和 Z Flip8 分别使用 45 微米、60 微米和 50 微米 UTG；苹果 iPhone Duo 则采用 45 微米 UTG 盖板。
报道显示，三星和苹果预计将在 2027 年第四季度决定是否将这项技术用于 2028 年折叠屏产品。在此之前，双方 2026 年机型仍将采用均匀厚度 UTG，2027 年也可能延续现有方案。
两家公司的技术路线也有差异。苹果 iPhone Duo 在 OLED 面板下方额外使用一层 40 微米 UTG，以帮助减轻折痕；三星目前仅在盖板层使用 UTG，对应位置采用钛金属，但同时也在开发面板下方 UTG 技术。

In the spot, a therapist is listening to a patient drone on when a cheap flight pops up on her iPhone. Her wallet is across the room and she can't get up to grab it, so she opens up the iPhone Wallet app, applies for an ‌Apple Card‌, and is able to purchase a flight within a couple of minutes. evidence.discovery_lead: From today, Apple's new iPad mini with an OLED display, M6 iMac, and its latest MacBook Pro models are available to buy from Apple's online store and in the Apple Store app, with the first pre-orders also arriving to customers today and both devices reaching Apple Store locations and Apple Authorized Resellers. OLED iPad Mini The eighth-generation iPad mini is Apple's smallest tablet with an OLED display. The 8.5-inch Super Retina XDR display offers up to 1,200 nits of peak brightness, a 2,000,000:1 contrast ratio, and a 1-nit minimum brightness, with a nano-texture glass option on 256GB and 512GB models for the first time. The device is powered by Apple's A20 Pro chip and the N1 wireless chip, enabling Wi-Fi 7 and Bluetooth 6. At 5.4mm thin and 255 grams, it's the lightest iPad Apple has made. It's also the first iPad with an IP67 water and dust resistance rating, aided by a new Acoustic Display that produces sound through the screen itself, so there are no speaker holes in the enclosure. A 12MP Center Stage front camera is now located on the landscape side for video calls, and the device supports Apple Pencil Pro and Apple Pencil (USB-C). units.text: OLED iPad Mini, M6 iMac, and New MacBook Pros Available From Today

From today, Apple's new iPad mini with an OLED display, M6 iMac, and its latest MacBook Pro models are available to buy from Apple's online store and in the Apple Store app, with the first pre-orders also arriving to customers today and both devices reaching Apple Store locations and Apple Authorized Resellers.
OLED iPad Mini

The eighth-generation iPad mini is Apple's smallest tablet with an OLED display. The 8.5-inch Super Retina XDR display offers up to 1,200 nits of peak brightness, a 2,000,000:1 contrast ratio, and a 1-nit minimum brightness, with a nano-texture glass option on 256GB and 512GB models for the first time.

The device is powered by Apple's A20 Pro chip and the N1 wireless chip, enabling Wi-Fi 7 and Bluetooth 6. At 5.4mm thin and 255 grams, it's the lightest iPad Apple has made. It's also the first iPad with an IP67 water and dust resistance rating, aided by a new Acoustic Display that produces sound through the screen itself, so there are no speaker holes in the enclosure.

A 12MP Center Stage front camera is now located on the landscape side for video calls, and the device supports Apple Pencil Pro and Apple Pencil (USB-C). The display is limited to a 60Hz refresh rate with no ProMotion, which has been the main point of criticism in early reviews.

In the United States, the new iPad mini starts at $699 for the 128GB Wi-Fi model. The 256GB and 512GB configurations are priced at $799 and $999, with nano-texture glass adding $100 on those models, while Wi-Fi + Cellular models start at $849. Education pricing starts at $649.
M6 iMac

Meanwhile, the new iMac is the first update to Apple's all-in-one since the M4 model. The M6 chip brings up to a 12-core CPU and 12-core GPU, with Apple claiming up to 2x faster graphics than the previous generation, alongside Wi-Fi 7, Bluetooth 6, and an optional 2.5 Gigabit Ethernet port on the power adapter.
The iMac with M6 starts at $1,499 for the model with a 10-core CPU and 10-core GPU, while the version with a 12-core CPU and 12-core GPU starts at $1,699. Education pricing starts at $1,449.
Latest MacBook Pro Models

Also launching today are the new MacBook Pro models. The 14-inch MacBook Pro with M6 starts at $1,999 and features a 12-core CPU and 12-core GPU, alongside Wi-Fi 7 and Bluetooth 6 via Apple's N1 wireless chip.

The new 14-inch and 16-inch MacBook Pro models with touchscreen PROLED XDR displays are also available, starting at $2,899 and $3,399, respectively. Powered by M5 Pro or M5 Max chips, the touchscreen models replace the notch with a Dynamic Island and offer up to 2,000 nits of peak brightness for both SDR and HDR content.

Apple's online checkout system indicates many configurations of the 14-inch and 16-inch touchscreen MacBook Pro models in Space Black and Silver currently ship in 2-3 weeks, so anyone who wants one as soon as possible is likely to have more luck visiting their local Apple Store, where at least some base configurations are typically in stock.
For a full rundown of everything new, see our iPad mini, iMac, and MacBook Pro roundups.

evidence.title: Swipeblocked catalogs the phrases Apple's keyboard won't suggest

units.text: Your iPhone's reluctance to suggest certain words runs the gamut from bodily functions all the way to Santa Claus, revealing some interesting boundaries in Apple's keyboard dictionary.
A new website, Swipeblocked, wants you to know that there are thousands of words and phrases your iPhone will not let you say. Except it will let you say every single one of them.
It just won't put those words in your mouth. Or hands, I suppose.

"The iPhone keyboard carries a hidden list of thousands of phrases it will never suggest or let you swipe," the website reads. "Alongside slurs, sex and drugs, the list covers political slogans, historical events and public figures."
To be clear: this isn't a new feature. For a long time, Apple has prioritized certain autocorrects and swiped words over others.
There is a reason for this. For example: a few slurs are one letter off from words you're more likely to use.
If Apple were to suggest those words instead of the more plausible word, it would land itself in hot water. Not to mention, no one wants to have to explain "I didn't mean to send that."
Unsurprisingly, autocorrect, predictive text, and swipe won't suggest offensive words. And how does it suss out what is and isn't offensive?
A massive internal dictionary, of course.

Apple's internal dictionary actually has three categories for words it won't suggest: vulgar, offensive, and sensitive. The full list of the offending words, along with what category they fall under, is here.
Of course, it's a good time to remind you that these words are, in fact, offensive. So if you click the link, you at least should know what you're in for.
Apple isn't stopping you from typing the whole word out yourself
As Swipeblocked points out: nothing stops you from typing any of these words. Apple just won't go out of its way to suggest them.

There are, however, other words and phrases that Apple's keyboard doesn't suggest, even if they don't fall in the aforementioned list. "Left wing conspiracy" is the one Swipeblocked mentions, saying that it changes it to "left wrong conspiracy."
Of course, halfway down the page it also points out that you can't swipe or predict "right wing conspiracy" or left and right wing propaganda.
Amusingly enough, you can't say "Santa isn't real" via swipe or predictive text, either.
"Apple doesn't publish the list or say how it's chosen. This site decodes it from the keyboard's own data files, as of iOS 27," Swipeblocked notes.

If you'd like to see the entire list of English blocked words and phrases, you can check them out here. Many of them are complete gibberish, such as "am some number ones most corrupt," so I'm not entirely sure what this list proves in the long run.

And, as Swipeblocked mentions, English isn't the only language that has suggestion blocks, either. It's every language, and for cultural reasons, some languages have different blocks than others. Don't salute the World War II German dictator, for instance.

At any rate, we here at AppleInsider are treating this as a curiosity. It's interesting to pull back the curtain from time to time to see how the technology works, but it shouldn't be seen as Apple's attempt to control how its users speak to each other.

units.text: The MacRumors Show: iOS 27.3 Looks Like a Huge Update

Apple's first 27.3 betas bring expanded Siri AI actions, a redesigned Health app, and new Fitness+ features, alongside conversation summaries on the Apple Watch. This week's episode of The MacRumors Show takes a closer look at the updates.
iOS 27.3 Beta's HUGE Features: Siri AI, Health, Fitness+ and More | Episode 217The MacRumors Show
Watch on YouTube
Subscribe to The MacRumors Show YouTube channel for more videos

‌Siri‌ AI gains additional actions across Apple's apps, including unsubscribing from mailing lists, organizing files, and managing Safari tabs. In Weather, ‌Siri‌ can add saved locations and toggle severe weather or next-hour precipitation notifications. The additions extend the assistant's usefulness for everyday tasks, although the full range of supported requests can still be difficult to discover.

A new developer preview also enables more flexible third-party integrations. Developers can supply custom actions and skills that help ‌Siri‌ coordinate multiple steps, improving its handling of more complicated requests. App Store submissions for these integrations are scheduled to open in the spring.

Safari adds vertical tabs and Adaptive Dark Mode, allowing websites without their own dark appearance to adopt one automatically. The iPhone Duo also gains horizontal Reachability and a revised keyboard, making its wider outer display easier to operate with one hand.

Apple Fitness+ gains Gym Strength, which creates personalized four-week plans based on available equipment and workout preferences. Short videos from Fitness+ trainers demonstrate proper form, extending the service beyond workouts that require following an entire video session. The initial beta's equipment selection and scheduling options nevertheless leave room for improvement, particularly for users whose routines vary from week to week.

The redesigned Health app returns with Insights and Longevity sections, turning collected measurements into more accessible guidance and longer-term health assessments. iPhone Duo-style StandBy mode displays bring more customizable clocks, Calendar views, and Weather information to additional iPhones. Apple Music also gains enhanced transitions, concert recommendations, and Selfie Sing karaoke videos.

On the Apple Watch, Live Rewind and Siri Recap introduce new ways to recover and summarize spoken information. Live Rewind provides a transcription of the preceding 15 seconds, while ‌Siri‌ Recap creates detailed conversation summaries that can be useful for meeting notes. Time- and location-based scheduling provides more control over when ‌Siri‌ Recap operates.

If you haven't already listened to the previous episode of The MacRumors Show, catch up to hear our discussion about Apple's newly announced OLED MacBook Pro, the iPad mini with A20 Pro, and M6 versions of the iMac and entry-level 14-inch ‌MacBook Pro‌.

You can also email us at podcast@macrumors.com or head over to The MacRumors Show forum thread. Remember to rate and review the podcast, and let us know what subjects and guests you would like to see in the future.

evidence.discovery_lead: IT之家 11 月 7 日消息，路透社昨日报道称，即将接任美国参议院常设调查小组委员会主席的民主党参议员理查德・布卢门撒尔（Richard Blumenthal），已经要求苹果、Meta、谷歌、英伟达、亚马逊和微软等参与特朗普白宫宴会捐款的科技企业主动提交相关文件，否则可能在 2027 年 1 月面临传票。 结合华盛顿邮报当地时间 11 月 6 日报道，民主党议员正在为明年展开的一系列企业调查做准备，苹果、Meta 以及马斯克旗下企业均可能成为调查对象。部分企业高管已经开始寻求律师协助，以应对可能到来的国会传票和调查。 苹果可能面临的调查之一，与其 App Store 下架 ICEBlock 等追踪 ICE 执法人员活动的应用有关。这类应用允许用户报告当地移民执法人员的活动，引发了有关执法人员安全和公众言论自由的争议。 苹果此前已经因这类应用受到民主党议员质询。2025 年 10 月，苹果在美国司法部施压后，从 App Store 下架了 ICEBlock 及其他类似应用。苹果当时表示，采取这一行动是出于联邦执法人员安全方面的考虑。此前，美国得克萨斯州达拉斯一处国土安全部设施遭枪击，造成两名被拘留人员死亡，美国联邦部门将袭击描述为针对 ICE 的暴力事件。 美国众议院司法委员会民主党首席成员杰米・拉斯金（Jamie Raskin）今年 9 月 29 日再次致信苹果，要求公司重新审查下架决定，并提供因联邦政府要求而从 App Store 移除的应用完整名单。拉斯金指出，苹果已经确认其下架 ICEBlock 的决定受到特朗普政府司法部施压影响，但司法部尚未提供能够直接证明该应用与达拉斯枪击事件有关的证据。他认为，此事可能涉及美国宪法第一修正案所保护的言论自由权利。 另一项可能引发国会调查的问题，是苹果向特朗普白宫宴会厅建设项目提供的捐款。据《华盛顿邮报》披露，苹果和英伟达分别承诺向该项目捐赠 2,500 万美元 （IT之家注：现汇率约合 1.67 亿元人民币） ，是已披露的主要企业捐赠方之一。 路透社称，布卢门撒尔要求企业提供与宴会厅项目捐款有关的记录，以便调查捐款的具体情况及其与特朗普政府之间的关系。他表示，如果民主党明年 1 月正式掌握相关委员会的调查权，而企业仍未提交文件，委员会将考虑采取其他措施强制配合。 相关阅读： 《 特朗普白宫宴会捐款名单曝光：苹果、英伟达各捐 2500 万美元为单笔最高金额 》 美国民主党议员正筹备调查，苹果因 App Store 下架 ICEBlock 应用、向特朗普宴会厅捐款 2500 万美元两项事由，面临国会调查风险。#苹果# 需主动提交相关文件，否则将收到传票。 美国民主党议员正筹备调查，苹果因 App Store 下架 ICEBlock 应用、向特朗普宴会厅捐款 2500 万美元两项事由，面临国会调查风险。#苹果# 需主动提交相关文件，否则将收到传票。

苹果此前已经因这类应用受到民主党议员质询。2025 年 10 月，苹果在美国司法部施压后，从 App Store 下架了 ICEBlock 及其他类似应用。苹果当时表示，采取这一行动是出于联邦执法人员安全方面的考虑。此前，美国得克萨斯州达拉斯一处国土安全部设施遭枪击，造成两名被拘留人员死亡，美国联邦部门将袭击描述为针对 ICE 的暴力事件。

美国众议院司法委员会民主党首席成员杰米・拉斯金（Jamie Raskin）今年 9 月 29 日再次致信苹果，要求公司重新审查下架决定，并提供因联邦政府要求而从 App Store 移除的应用完整名单。拉斯金指出，苹果已经确认其下架 ICEBlock 的决定受到特朗普政府司法部施压影响，但司法部尚未提供能够直接证明该应用与达拉斯枪击事件有关的证据。他认为，此事可能涉及美国宪法第一修正案所保护的言论自由权利。
另一项可能引发国会调查的问题，是苹果向特朗普白宫宴会厅建设项目提供的捐款。据《华盛顿邮报》披露，苹果和英伟达分别承诺向该项目捐赠 2,500 万美元（IT之家注：现汇率约合 1.67 亿元人民币），是已披露的主要企业捐赠方之一。
路透社称，布卢门撒尔要求企业提供与宴会厅项目捐款有关的记录，以便调查捐款的具体情况及其与特朗普政府之间的关系。他表示，如果民主党明年 1 月正式掌握相关委员会的调查权，而企业仍未提交文件，委员会将考虑采取其他措施强制配合。
